user.title: Nea Smart base
user.description: Enter the IP address or host name of the Alpha 2 base. Its XML interface must be reachable on the local network.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the base
error.invalid_response: The base answered with an invalid XML document

write_zone_value.name: Write heat area value
write_zone_value.description: Write a single XML element inside a HEATAREA section of the base.

entry_id.name: Configuration entry
entry_id.description: The Nea Smart entry to target. Required only if several bases are configured.

zone.name: Heat area number
zone.description: The nr attribute of the target HEATAREA (1 to 12).

tag.name: Element
tag.description: The XML element to write, for example T_TARGET.

value.name: Value
value.description: The value to send, for example 20.5.

write_device_value.name: Write base value
write_device_value.description: Write a single element at device level, optionally nested.

entry_id.name: Configuration entry
entry_id.description: The Nea Smart entry to target. Required only if several bases are configured.

path.name: Element path
path.description: The element path, for example COOLING or RELAIS/FUNCTION.

value.name: Value
value.description: The value to send, for example 1.
